resetMail.subject: Reset your Overpass password
resetMail.body:
Hello,

To choose a new password, open this link within 30 minutes:

{{link}}

The link works once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: your password stays the same.

The Overpass team

confirmMail.subject: Confirm your Overpass sign-up
confirmMail.body:
Hello,

To finish signing up, open this link within 24 hours:

{{link}}

If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: no account was created.

The Overpass team
